displacements.note: Displacement on the +X wall inner face of a 128x128x128 room (x=64 plane, normal -X into the room). Its backing extrudes +X (thickness 16, x 64..80) and plugs the wall the displacement leaves open.

gap.note: LeakFinder gap portal centre in the +X wall, at player height. The unbacked graph (LeakGraph.RoomWithGap) leaks through it; the backed graph seals.
